summary: Evotec SE filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 13, 2026 ad hoc announcement under Article 17 MAR, disclosing preliminary unaudited nine-month 2026 results ahead of market expectations and reaffirming full-year guidance. Preliminary Group revenues were approximately EUR 465.0 million with adjusted EBITDA of about EUR -42.8 million; full-year 2026 guidance remains EUR 570-610 million revenue (EUR 595-635 million at CER) and adjusted EBITDA of EUR -70 to -105 million (-60 to -90 million at CER). No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are involved; full results are scheduled for November 5, 2026.
